Name: Dreamlurker
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: This living lance floats and bobs in the air like a jellyfish, but is capable of making its body rigid and launching at a target like an arrow. When near a creature it can steal memories from, it attempts to latch onto them and put them to sleep, then invades their dreams and saps them. These creatures are cautious until they decide to attack, at which point they swarm with reckless abandon.

Stat Blocks.title: Dreamlurker
languages: understands the languages of creatures it has taken memories from, but doesn’t speak

actions.name: Latch
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet of the dreamlurker must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the dreamlurker latches onto them. The target is grappled (escape DC 14), and while grappled this way they must attempt a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of their turns. On a failure they are inflicted with weak amniasis and their Wisdom score is immediately reduced by 1.

actions.name: Spear Dive
actions.description: The dreamlurker sharpens its body to a point and launches itself as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the dreamlurker ends the attack in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target (even if they miss).

actions.name: Sleep Aura
actions.description: The dreamlurker forces all non-aberration creatures within 5 feet of it to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that fail fall unconscious for 1 minute, and cannot be awoken by noise. These creatures only awaken if they take damage or another creature uses an action to shake them awake.
